subject: Emerald AI retention ask — exec approval for >20% Hosted API discount
messages:
From: Jennifer Alvarez <jennifer@emeraldai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API renewal — urgent pricing ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're moving toward conversion but hit a budget wall on our end for Q4. Our CFO reviewed the usage profile and asked if Redwood can extend a deeper retention discount to secure a 12-month commitment.

Request: 30% off Hosted API list rates for the first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month committed spend (forecast attached).
Why: Emerald AI is consolidating inference spend onto Redwood for all inference calls across product and R&D; losing this discount risks us pausing the onboarding.

I've attached our forecast (Emerald_AI_usage_forecast_Q4-2026.xlsx) and a first-pass SOW. Can you escalate to your team for executive approval? We need an answer by EOD Friday to make internal budget timelines.

Best,
Jennifer Alvarez\Head of Partnerships\Emerald AI

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Alvarez <jennifer@emeraldai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 13:10:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal — urgent pricing ask

Hi Jennifer — thanks for the context and the forecast. Looping in Ben, Markus and Mina to get a rapid decision.

Quick summary for exec slate: Emerald AI is requesting a 30% hosted-API rate concession in return for a 12-month committed spend. They project steady ramp to ~5.5B tokens/mo by month 6 (see attached). The ask is time-sensitive (internal Emerald budget).

Initial constraints we should consider:
- We prefer a structured discount tied to committed spend tiers vs a flat list-rate cut.
- Require a minimum 12-month term and a usage-based true-up (to protect unit economics).
- Prefer prepay or 50% upfront to reduce credit exposure for a new large customer.

Ben/Markus/Mina — can you weigh in on acceptable band and approvals needed? If we need exec signoff, please indicate the max% and any gating conditions.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts\Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 17:02:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal — urgent pricing ask

Kim — I reviewed the forecast and ran preliminary unit economics with Ops. Emerald looks strategic (industry footprint + reference potential), so I recommend we approve a concession but with guardrails. Proposed commercial terms I support: 

- Discount: 25% off Hosted API list rates in months 1-12
- Commit: 12-month committed spend equal to the forecast (with monthly reporting)
- Payment: 50% upfront, remainder net-30 monthly
- SLAs: Standard enterprise SLA (99.9%) with a 30-day remediation window; do not include premium SLOs without added fee
- True-up: Quarterly true-up; if usage exceeds forecast by >30%, discount scales back to 15% for the remainder of the term

Rationale: 25% gets us into a defensible range (high-value reference). The prepay reduces credit risk. The true-up protects long-tail economics.

If Finance can live with 25%, I'll escalate to Marcus for final exec clearance.

-Ben
SVP, Sales

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:15:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal — urgent pricing ask

I ran the numbers with Finance. 25% is aggressive given Emerald's credit profile (new customer; forecast front-loaded). Finance position: max headroom is 22% with either (a) full 12-month prepay OR (b) a secured payment plan + corporate guarantee. If we accept 25%, we need deferred revenue treatment and a reserve against churn that will impact short-term rev recognition.

Also request:
- Customer must complete SOC2 questionnaire and provide references before billing starts.
- Add a clause limiting the discount to Hosted API calls only (no additional promotional credits for other services).

If Sales wants to push for 25%, provide a signed letter of intent and commit to the prepay structure; otherwise Finance will only clear up to 22%.

Mina
Head of Finance

---
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:46:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal — urgent pricing ask

Agree with Ben's commercial guardrails. Given the strategic upside, I'm comfortable recommending an executive concession. I will put a note for Marcus to approve formally. My recommendation to Marcus is: 23% discount, conditioned on 12-month committed spend, 50% upfront payment, SOC2 evidence within 30 days, and a quarterly true-up with a scale-back if usage outpaces forecast by >30%.

Markus
VP, Revenue Operations

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal — urgent pricing ask

I reviewed the thread and the attachments (Emerald forecast + SOW draft). I authorize an executive concession of 23% off Hosted API list rates for Emerald AI, subject to the following conditions which must be captured in the DocuSign term-sheet before the discount is applied: 

1) 12-month minimum committed spend per the attached forecast; 50% of the total committed value paid upfront.
2) Standard enterprise SLA to apply; any premium SLOs billed separately.
3) SOC2 questionnaire completed and basic security evidence provided within 30 days of signing.
4) Quarterly true-up. If actual usage exceeds forecast by >30% in a quarter, discount steps down to 15% for remaining term.
5) Discount is limited to Hosted API usage (no add-on credits).

Kimberly/Ben: proceed to finalize the DocuSign with the conditions above and secure the prepay. Once signed, Ops/Finance will provision the discounted pricing band.

Marcus Lin
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
